static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.family_status: Mother passed away in childhood, no siblings
static_traits.social_status: Avoiding socializing with colleagues and friends in professional settings; has an industry mentor but struggles to open up about 'lack of confidence / sense of incompetence'
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy or counseling in the past
static_traits.language_features: Overall pessimistic attitude, skeptical; marked Self-denial; able to state experiences and feelings clearly, willing to try behavioral experiments; cautious tone

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I am the worst Chef in history, although cooking is my passion and profession; this negative belief is affecting my confidence in the kitchen and impacting Work performance.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative beliefs are hindering me from enjoying cooking and performing well professionally.
growth_experiences: Growing up, Mother passed away in childhood, no siblings in the family, lacking peer and immediate-family support and companionship while growing up (original family structure: Single parent/bereaved).

A marked sense of incompetence began during culinary school: any feedback about cooking (regardless of positive or negative) triggers Self-doubt; bearing constant pressure to prove oneself, trying to improve skills through extra courses and workshops, yet the negative beliefs persist.

special_situations.event: Receiving positive feedback about the dishes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others praise me, it is only out of politeness or luck, and does not prove I am really capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Taking more courses and workshops to 'prove' oneself against unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just comforting me / I was just lucky

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback or criticism about cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One piece of negative feedback proves my ability is inadequate, I may just be a failed Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing with colleagues and friends in professional settings, reducing opportunities for exposure to evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This proves I am bad / I am just not capable

special_situations.event: Doing daily Work in the kitchen or trying new dishes/new techniques, needing to publicly demonstrate skills
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must be perfect; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tends to choose simpler dishes or over-practice in pursuit of 'zero errors'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If not perfect, it means I am worthless

special_situations.event: Reviews a cooking performance or the overall feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as there is a flaw, it means the overall performance is not good
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing attention on mistakes and inadequacies, ignoring any positive changes or progress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am always making mistakes / cannot see any progress

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and affirmed in cooking, recognized as a capable Chef
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and criticized, worrying that one negative review proves oneself not good enough
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being evaluated by staying cautious and avoidant
Avoiding exposing vulnerability to protect fragile self-esteem

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, a 'person being judged' who may be negated at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh, hard-to-please others/audience with critical evaluations

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving positive feedback about the dishes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously interpreting others' praise as 'politeness/luck', not acknowledging one's own ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using statements that downplay positive evaluation (like 'just good luck'), restrained tone with self-mockery; avoiding deep discussion of one's own strengths.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving negative feedback or doubts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treats one criticism as total failure, falling into an 'all good / all bad' evaluation pattern
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using absolutist statements (like 'I am just the worst'), low tone; ignoring concrete details and room for improvement.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to open up to a mentor or peers about lack of confidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting one's own worries as others' views, believing the other will look down on oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using speculative statements (like 'they will think I do not deserve it'), reducing eye contact, cautious tone, being vague, avoiding further interaction.

manifestations: Loving cooking yet 'losing the joy' due to persistent Self-denial
Career investment consumed by constant Self-doubt
Positive feedback cannot be accepted, personal sense of worth hard to establish

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Holds 'must prove oneself excellent' as the inner standard
Treats one negative feedback as absolute failure (others' standards swallowed directly)

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing others are only being polite, not genuinely approving
Inferring the mentor will look down on oneself and thus struggling to open up

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Restrained tone in communication; hard to express true needs

positive_force: Strong passion for cooking and professional dedication
Proactive learning: attending extra courses and workshops
Has potential support resources: an industry mentor to seek guidance from
negative_force: Marked Self-denial and Anxiety, doubting ability daily
Negating positive feedback, Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking
Excessively dependent on external evaluation; hard to internalize self-worth
Avoiding interaction in professional socializing, reducing access to feedback and support
Stress eating and Sleep disturbance weakening physical and mental state

target_behavior.behavior: Immediately Self-denying and escalating Anxiety upon receiving cooking feedback
antecedent: Any situation involving positive or negative feedback about cooking
Moments at work requiring evaluation or comments
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by the core belief 'I am the worst Chef / I am not good enough', and long bearing the pressure of 'must prove myself'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of being negated and the resulting Anxiety (preemptively defending through Self-deprecation)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence, impaired Work performance, worsened Anxiety and Continuing self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: In professional settings, avoids social interaction with colleagues and friends
antecedent: Occasions of team communication, industry events, and talking with mentors
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged not good enough by others, mind-reading that others will look down on oneself
target_behavior.function: Avoiding outside evaluation and criticism, reducing discomfort and tension in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced Social support and career resources, further affecting Career development and confidence Recovery

antecedent: Tension arising after being evaluated or reviewing performance
target_behavior.core_reason: Rising Anxiety levels, ongoing threats to self-worth leading to using eating and sleep as emotion regulation
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental state declines, attention and energy are impaired, further affecting work performance and learning outcomes
